name: dsdv_mu_hslot
structural_change: MU-S81-2/HSLOT2 10-19: STRUCTURAL RE-DESIGN of dsdv_mu_hslot after the FLOORPLAN_MARGIN refusal of dsdv_mu_hslot-7046f5b72 (util 66%) and SAFE-AUDIT-S81 items 3/5/6/7 (rp[1] 3,007 loads; 4.1 kb runtime-indexed flop tables; io_hold 0.025). RTL: the per-entry due table (47 x 32 b), the 32 b edge counter, the 47:1 x 32 b due compare and the sweep pointer rp are removed: returns follow a second walk of the slot gap table started RL - 1 edges after the arming start (return slot k's boundary = start slot k's boundary + RL - 1 = every recorded start's due edge; RL - 1 >= period raises t_mf[3]). Reset relay in 3 regions (<= ~250 flops each). All pointers are registered one-hot vectors (each bit enables only its own entry, <= 32 loads); every table read is a one-hot AND-OR into a register (gap prefetch ng / rng, return entry rq read the edge before its boundary); start payload and gap words land in (* keep *) pin-flop copies, one per <= 16 / <= 24 entries. Tables now 2.6 kb flops (user, pos, gap), written only at a start / boot word and read only through registered one-hot reads. Pins, faces, boot words, t_ku edge and fault codes unchanged; zero added schedule cycles. Previous: slot gap table re-close (5dd45e769) of the CLOSED view 28a8118d5. Kit: outline from the new synthesis area (gate 2: 2,312 um2; +~90 um2 for the 3-region reset relay) at ~0.52 util, io_hold_margin 0.03, reset_landing 2 stages. CODEX: position table47x21 moved into registered-read SRAM with WREG forwarding. Binary shadows advance with the one-hot start/return walks. Dense flop payload remaining user470+gap1128=1598bits. Same output edges; no added schedule latency. New macro floorplan, SRAM on43.2 lattice, full-width std cell band.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: f_ks / f_kd / f_mc land in pin flops (st_q + kept kp_q copies / kd_q / mv_q, ms_q + kept md_q copies), t_ku / t_mf leave flops.
